items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: Charlie Parker come up here with Jay McShann.

ctx.x: Now, when was the first time that you heard Charlie Parker?
Well, the first time, see, Charlie Parker come up here with Jay McShann. I'd been hearing Charlie Parker because he's been around here a lot of times.

Because Eddie Barefield (phonetic) -- Eddie Barefield, he was something else too, you know. They were coming out from out West doing all types of things, and Eddie Barefield was a demon, in fact, when there's a demon about, jazz demon, you'll hear about him. You'll hear him. Don't worry about it.
